difficulty_reason: The selected composite-ring lower bound requires a new decoding construction for derivative evaluations on cyclotomic torus lines and control of rank after quotienting to characteristic p, beyond the ordinary finite-field vanishing argument. The human proof extends coefficient-matrix tensor-rank amplification to a polynomial quotient ring and preserves line offsets depending on every Chinese-remainder direction factor during induction. The complete prime-power multiplicity argument and sharpened Vandermonde diagonal count in Appendix A supply the dimension-dependent product constant, so the primary obligation is a substantive research result rather than an auxiliary field-only Kakeya estimate.
